summary_zh: 前文围绕The Trade Desk财报中ROAS能力争议：Drew质疑其效果广告定位，lafforug举General Mills用零售数据提升ROAS案例。收录帖承认案例精选，但转向TTD若结合Walmart、Costco、主品牌等零售商数据，广告主会继续投入。后续补充称收入走势可验证Jeff说法，有助判断该舆情偏投资分析、情绪审慎乐观，传播价值取决于后续业绩印证。

posts.text:
You have to read earnings calls very carefully. 

This is a line from CEO Jeff Green from $TTD's last quarter. 

This is the subtle line that I think validates my thesis that the bigger reason they have been struggling has to do with advertisers moving the goal post of what counts as "performance" advertising and them not being well positioned to provide ROAS metrics.

posts.translation_zh:
你必须非常仔细地阅读财报电话会议记录。

这是 $TTD 上个季度 CEO Jeff Green 说的一句话。

这句微妙的话，我认为验证了我的论点：他们一直举步维艰的更大原因，是广告主在改变什么算作“效果”广告的标准，而他们并没有很好地定位自己来提供 ROAS 指标。

posts.text: @DrewCohenMoney Jeff explained how they solved their ROAS challenge using retail data.
